# NuvexaDB

- Package: Nuventra.NuvexaDB
- File: .nvx (binary, optional AES-256-GCM)
- Query: Mongo-like db.collection.find({ }).sort().limit(); aggregate $match/$lookup/$count; LINQ Where on GetCollection<T>
- Files: db.Files GridFS-style fs.files / fs.chunks
- Platforms: net8.0 / net9.0 / net10.0; MAUI Android, iOS, Mac Catalyst, Windows
- Bindings: Native AOT C ABI v2 (`nuvexa_*`) + Kotlin/Java + Swift + Flutter + React Native + Python + Node + Go + C++. Architecture: docs/architecture.md
- Explorer: Avalonia (Win/macOS/Linux). VS + VS Code custom editors.
- Encryption: fail-closed. Lib throws NuvexaEncryptionException. IDE prompts for key.
- Not a server. SQLite is not the source of truth.
- Complementary: Plugin.Maui.OfflineSync, Plugin.Maui.JobQueue, Plugin.Maui.FileVault
